amendment.reason: Q5 still failed force convergence at the 45-degree endpoint after 4000 conservative FIRE steps. Test an independent optimizer and double precision at the same original endpoint geometry.
amendment.scope: One CPU/float64 L-BFGS-B fixed-cell diagnostic with analytic forces and a local directional finite-difference check. No change to potential, source loading trajectories or primary queue.
amendment.interpretation: Optimizer and numerical precision both differ from Q5. This checks whether a lower-residual state is obtainable, not which individual change causes a difference. It cannot establish a corrected loading path or transverse-equilibrated failure endpoint.
amendment.technical_correction: Q6 failed before optimization because the diagnostic adapter did not initialize its neighbor list. Q6 output and original script are preserved. Q6b initializes that list; scientific optimizer, precision, geometry and budgets are unchanged.

engine.implementation: TorchRebo2Scr (PyTorch autograd port of Atomistica Rebo2Scr kernel)
engine.parameterization: Brenner 2002 + Pastewka 2008 screening; Atomistica default tables; dihedral=False
citations: D. W. Brenner, O. A. Shenderova, J. A. Harrison, S. J. Stuart, B. Ni, S. B. Sinnott, J. Phys.: Condens. Matter 14, 783 (2002).
L. Pastewka, P. Pou, R. Perez, P. Gumbsch, M. Moseler, Phys. Rev. B 78, 161402(R) (2008).
L. Pastewka, A. Klemenz, P. Gumbsch, M. Moseler, Phys. Rev. B 87, 205410 (2013).
Atomistica, https://github.com/Atomistica/atomistica (L. Pastewka et al.), version 1.2.7.
engine.units: eV, Angstrom; 2D stress in eV/A^2 (x16.0218 = N/m)

interpretation: Optimizer success is not substituted for force/transverse residual checks; this fixed-cell configuration is not a repaired loading trajectory.
